# Getting help

## Questions

Open an issue with the [question form](https://github.com/andrew-abdelmalak/connect-4-robot/issues/new?template=question.yml). Check the [README](../README.md) and the [paper](../docs/Vision-Based-Connect-4-Robot.pdf) first; most setup and wiring questions are answered there.

## Bugs

Use the [bug report form](https://github.com/andrew-abdelmalak/connect-4-robot/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).

## Security problems

Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## What we do not support

Builds that differ from the course robot. The HSV thresholds, carriage times, and pulse counts are tuned for this board, camera mount, and dispenser, and we cannot debug other setups.
